eligibility.rule: Site owned by a 501(c)(3) or government agency, managed as a natural area open to the public, wholly in Illinois
eligibility.quote: Eligible project sites are properties owned by a 501c3 organization, or a government agency, on which the applicant regularly performs, or is planning to regularly perform stewardship work, and is being managed as a natural habitat and wildlife area that is or will be open to the public. All projects must be wholly in Illinois.

eligibility.rule: One application per cycle; up to $30,000 over an 18-month grant
eligibility.quote: The grant period will be 18 months for all projects. Applicants may only submit one application per grant cycle. Grantees are eligible to receive up to $30,000.

eligibility.rule: Pass a basic eligibility quiz before the full proposal
eligibility.quote: applicants will need to complete a basic eligibility quiz to ensure applicants organization and project sites are eligible under this program.

documents.item: Project work plan (site, objectives, methods, volunteer base)

documents.quote: A letter of approval from the landowner of your project site approving the applicant to carry out the proposed grant work on the site.
Maps showing the location of the work site

documents.item: Operating budgets for the last and next fiscal year
documents.quote: Organizational or departmental operating budgets - one for the most recent fiscal year and one for the upcoming fiscal year, if available.

documents.item: Latest financial report (balance sheet, income statement, notes)
documents.quote: A financial report for the most recent fiscal year, including Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and any notes to the financial statements

documents.item: IRS EIN letter and 501(c)(3) determination letter
documents.quote: IRS letter confirming EIN IRS Tax Status Determination Letter (for 501c3 applicants only)

documents.item: Latest Illinois Charitable Organization Annual Report
documents.quote: Your organization's most recent Illinois Charitable Organization Annual Report filed with the Illinois Attorney General's Office

effort.step: Pass the eligibility quiz, then submit the full proposal in the grant portal
effort.quote: The period to submit Full Proposals will begin in 2027 on July 14th and close on September 17th

effort.step: Review can take three months or more; awards are notified in late spring
effort.quote: PSCC's full proposal review process can take up to 3 months or longer.

co_finance_required.quote: Cash donations: PSCC will provide $3 to every $1 raised toward the project within the grant period, up to $21,000.

after_award.quote: submit both the "before" and "after" photos with your final report.
alt_quotes: a detailed post-grant budget must be submitted with the final report

notes: A challenge grant in three parts: $3 for every $1 the grantee raises (up to $21,000), $4,000 once 400 volunteer hours are logged, and up to $5,000 of equipment at 100%. Only the cash part needs money raised; in-kind goods count toward it. Payment requests with proof go in every four months. The next full-proposal window is 14 July to 17 September 2027.
